name: Steak Salad with Charred Broccoli, Celery, Tomatoes & Blue Cheese
ingredients: 1 ½ lb striploin (New York strip) steak
instructions: Preheat oven to broil on high; position rack under the broiler.
Wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the mixed greens if they came pre-washed.)

Separate broccoli into bite-sized florets and cut stems into smaller pieces; transfer to a large baking sheet pan. Drizzle with oil, season with salt and crushed red pepper, toss to combine, and spread out in an even layer.
Place baking sheet in the oven and broil, tossing halfway through, until broccoli is crisp-tender and lightly charred around the edges, 12-15 minutes. Remove from oven and set aside to cool.
Meanwhile, juice lemon into a large bowl.
Peel and mince garlic. Add to the bowl with the lemon juice along with oil, Dijon, salt, and pepper; whisk to combine the dressing and set aside.
Preheat a large skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, pat the steak dry with paper towels and place on a plate. Season with salt and pepper on both sides.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add steak to the skillet and cook until desired doneness, 2-5 minutes per side. Transfer to a clean plate and let rest, about 5 minutes.
Meanwhile, halve tomatoes. Trim and thinly slice celery crosswise; add both to the bowl with the dressing.
Chop chives into small pieces and add to the bowl.
Add charred broccoli, mixed greens, and blue cheese to the bowl; toss to combine the salad and set aside.
Thinly slice steak against the grain.
To serve, divide salad and steak between plates or bowls. Enjoy!
author: Mealime
